messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads up — audio seems pretty low on the stream for anyone watching? I can hear the speakers but it's quieter than usual. Also flag: leadership Q&A still at 14:00 but we might shift start by ~5m while we fix AV.
Owen Patel: On it, starting a gain check now. @Jamie (Oncall) can you confirm encoder audio levels from the control room?
Jamie (Oncall): seeing OBS input at -18dB on the encoder. Bumping +6dB on the mixer now, will watch for clipping. Please mute any standby mics.
Taylor Brooks: Can we swap order — put the roadmap after the live Q&A? I need an extra minute to swap slides.
Maya Chen: Fine to swap roadmap to after Q&A, will update the agenda doc and announce at the top.
Samir Gupta: If captions break, we have a local fallback. Run this on presenter laptop:
```bash
./captions-local.sh --device=usb-mic --lang=en
```
Samir Gupta: Also: note to presenters — stay ~15cm from the mic for best gain.
deploy-bot: Stream health check: latency=120ms, dropped_frames=0, current_bitrate=4.2Mbps
Owen Patel: I saw a tiny dip at 14:03 when we toggled the mixer, recording is still rolling. Jamie, can you clip the Q&A intro in case we need a highlight?
Maya Chen: :thumbsup: yes please clip 0:02:15-0:04:20 and drop it in the all-hands clips folder.
Taylor Brooks: Uploaded the updated roadmap deck: https://drive.redwood/roadmap/apr-update-v2 — I updated the bullets per the pre-read.
Jamie (Oncall): Good to go in 3m. If audio reads below -12dB again, ping me and I'll hold the stage.
Maya Chen: Thank you team. After the meeting, can eng-ops grab the encoder logs and the OBS settings dump? I'll add follow-ups to the post-meeting doc.
Owen Patel: Roger that — I'll paste logs here after the meeting ends.
Maya Chen: OK starting in ~2m. Everyone please keep pings to urgent only during the stream.
